import numpy as np

def process(y_raw):
    # Ensure y_raw is a flat numpy array
    y_raw = np.asarray(y_raw).flatten()
    
    # 1. Baseline correction using linear interpolation between two points
    # Point 1: avg intensity at 1100 cm-1 (+/- 10)
    mask_b1 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
    val_1 = np.mean(y_raw[mask_b1]) if np.any(mask_b1) else 0
    
    # Point 2: avg intensity at 1800 cm-1 (+/- 10)
    mask_b2 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)
    val_2 = np.mean(y_raw[mask_b2]) if np.any(mask_b2) else 0
    
    # Create baseline array across the x-range
    baseline = np.interp(x, [1100, 1800], [val_1, val_2])
    y_corr = y_raw - baseline
    
    # 2. Normalize to G-band max in 1550-1620 cm-1
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    if np.any(mask_g):
        g_max = np.max(y_corr[mask_g])
        if g_max > 0:
            return y_corr / g_max
        else:
            return y_corr
    return y_corr

# Plotkit handles 'combine' by passing lists for x and y1 if multiple files/sheets are used.
